title: I Editor
description: Edit the various elements of the item.
body:
## I Editor: A Revolution in the World of Minecraft and Customization

![Menu I Editor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c00175c10e3fd5e6ae07a3d886a169d38f24e544.png)

**I Editor (Item Editor)** - universal editing tool for multiple item elements. The editor is based on the vanilla mechanics of the game, which allow you to change the properties of an object in various ways.

Edit whatever you want, what you don't like about the subject, you can always change or supplement it in a coordinated way.

## **Editing Elements:**

### Visual
- Name
- Lore
- Model
- Display Tooltips
- Book Cover
- Firework

### Technical
- Custom Data
- Custom Model Data
- Attribute
- Component
- Enchantment
- Potion
- Damage
- Count

-----

⚠️ **Important:** All editing functions are performed through commands. Make sure command usage is allowed on your server or world to unlock the full potential of this project.

![Set Potion](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3c2cc3e691c21b0befe671c36649da3c1fa1c149_0.webp)

### Report Bugs
If you find an error in this project, feel free to visit the GitHub page or write to us in Discord.
